en: The image shows a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a woman wearing traditional Greek attire, drawing water from a well. The photograph is framed by a decorative border. Above the photograph is a colorful Greek flag with a crown emblem, indicating the period of the Greek monarchy. The flag is prominently displayed on a flagpole, occupying the left side of the postcard. At the bottom of the image, text identifies the subject as 'COSTUME GREC. ATHÈNES.'
